services.desc: Experience an extraordinary tiki bar cruise in Miami, Florida! You can even book your own private party for birthdays, bachelorette and bachelor parties, and other celebrations. Book your Miami Beach tiki bar cruise online today! Why go bar hopping… when you can hop on the bar! Cruise the popular Miami River. Pick up a couple of your favorite beverages and relax… but be prepared to have your picture taken because you’re aboard the most photographed boat on the water! - Enjoy! Why be crammed on a boat with 100 other people when you can be treated like THE celebrity! Admire the homes (and boats) of Miami’s biggest celebrities (both past and present) on this narrated tour!
